summary.headline: Contents and Astrological Appendix
summary.text: Table of contents for the catalogue of Florentine astrological manuscripts, followed by an appendix of important testimonies concerning Greek astrologers. It lists excerpts from Vettius Valens, Palchus, Lydus, Masala, Apomasaris, Samspuchari, Hephaestion, and selected Palchus chapters on loss, runaways, thieves, inceptions, flights, and confinements.
